en.title: 3D: sharp hard surfaces, levels of detail, baked models and preview notes
en.body: The mesh option `sharp` keeps hard surfaces hard: vertices placed where the surface's planes meet (dual contouring) and normals split at creases, so crates, walls and machines keep their corners and flat faces. `createSdfLod3D` makes a model in levels of detail, each simplified from the one before. `node tools/bake-models.mjs` makes models ahead of time in Node and writes each as a .glb: the library's 24 models bake in about 16 seconds and then load in about 50 milliseconds. The model preview lists notes: a mesh in several pieces, a model below or above the ground, a slow one. The check found three loose parts in the library (a dog's tail, a door slab, a well's lid), now fixed, and its test holds every model to one piece.

zh.title: 3D：锐利的硬表面、多级细节、预烘焙模型和预览提示
zh.body: 网格选项 `sharp` 让硬表面保持硬朗：顶点放在表面平面的交汇处（对偶轮廓法），在折角处拆分法线，木箱、墙和机械保留棱角和平整的面。`createSdfLod3D` 生成多级细节的模型，每一级由上一级减面而来。`node tools/bake-models.mjs` 在 Node 里提前生成模型，每个写成 .glb：范例库的 24 个模型约 16 秒烘焙完，之后约 50 毫秒全部加载。模型预览会列出提示：网格分成几块、模型陷进地面或浮在空中、生成太慢。这项检查在范例库里找到三处松脱的零件（狗尾巴、门板、水井的盖子），都已修好，测试要求每个模型都是一整块。
